name: TEMPESTA GT3

specs.notes: Lamborghini Squadra Corse's Huracán GT3 (EVO2 shape, 2022 on): the naturally aspirated 5,204 cc 90-degree V10 behind the driver, just over 500 bhp to ~560 hp depending on the class's balance of performance, a pneumatic six-speed Xtrac sequential, 1,230 kg dry, a 2,645-2,648 mm wheelbase (the team's spec sheets). Run to the APEX GT CHALLENGE's balance of performance (laps CINDER RIDGE within a few tenths of the AFFALTER GT3 on the AI's line); its torque curve, aero and ratios are estimates.

garage.blurb: A wedge with a screaming V10 behind your shoulders: it rotates the moment you lift, howls to 8,500 rpm and rewards a driver who commits on the way in.

interior.notes: The model's race cockpit (cage, carbon dash, seat, nets): its wheel cut out of the merged interior by a box (tools/cars/huracan_gt3.json), the column axis and the eye set by hand (the roof probe found only the cage); paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.
